reviews.message: Reviewed D3: extracted pure projection retains thresholds, excludes raw traits from projections and never ticks state. Legacy transition still decays on null; V3 hold is enforced by service routing, not by changing the legacy policy. Projection and V3 missing-input regressions passed.
